hook: GPT-6 can design proteins that actually bind.
hookText: GPT-6 can design proteins that actually bind.

beats.say: OpenAI reports GPT-6 models show intrinsic protein-design capabilities, with lab screens finding binding in 75 of 88 designs for MDM2, 85 percent.
beats.statLabel: of MDM2 designs bound in lab screens

beats.say: It also found 26 of 42 designs binding for VEGF-A, 62 percent, and 8 of 59 for PD-1, 14 percent.
Of 272 fragments based on five therapeutic antibodies, 179 showed binding to their original target, PD-1 or PD-L1, 66 percent.
